description: The file defines the main components and routing logic for the home page of a React-based Next.js application, including dynamic imports, theme handling, language setup, and initial data loading.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A React component that displays a loading indicator, optionally without a logo.

methods.name: useSwitchTheme
methods.description: A custom hook that manages theme switching (light/dark/auto) based on user configuration.

methods.name: useHtmlLang
methods.description: A custom hook that sets the HTML document language attribute based on locale.

methods.name: useHasHydrated
methods.description: A custom hook that determines if the React component tree has been hydrated.

methods.name: loadAsyncGoogleFont
methods.description: A function that dynamically loads Google Fonts by appending a stylesheet link to the document.

methods.name: Screen
methods.description: Main functional component handling routing and layout of the app's different pages.

methods.name: useLoadData
methods.description: A custom hook that initializes the API client based on configuration and loads available models.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main exported component combining theme, data, language setup, and rendering the app with routing.
